name: Bukit Jalil Sports City
summary: Bukit Jalil sports city: the National Sports Complex (National Stadium, Axiata Arena, the National Aquatic Centre), Pavilion Bukit Jalil and Bukit Jalil City, and Bukit Jalil Recreational Park, along the Sri Petaling Line (Bukit Jalil, Awan Besar, Muhibbah).

name: KLCC
summary: Kuala Lumpur City Centre: the Petronas Twin Towers, Suria KLCC, KLCC Park, the KL Convention Centre and Ombak KLCC, around KLCC LRT (KJ10, Kelana Jaya Line) and Persiaran KLCC MRT (PY21, Putrajaya Line).

name: KL Eco City – Mid Valley
summary: The rail-and-mall cluster on both banks of the Klang River: KL Eco City, The Gardens Mall and Mid Valley Megamall, around Abdullah Hukum (LRT + KTM) and Mid Valley KTM.
